title: Records made with the Halfway House band
summary: He recalls tunes cut with Schilling's band including Barataria and Pussycat Rag, and who played saxophone and clarinet.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I had, I know I got a picture of it. Do you remember any of the tunes you cut with the halfway house?

Uh, Barrettaria. Uh. Some Sweetheart tune. Nobody, nobody's a sweetheart. Uh uh. Let me call you Sweetheart. Barrettaria. Uh. One of Red Long's tunes. Uh. When I was loving you, you were loving someone else. Oh yeah. Uh. When they were doing that we had Joe Loicano on saxophone and his brother singing. Either his brother or Johnny Sabre singing. And uh. Well I made a bunch of them at the halfway house.
Now Barrettaria, you remember who the guys in the band? Rap was on that.
And what was he playing then? He was playing saxophone. Not clarinet. Charlie Cadilla was playing the sax, playing the clarinet. Rap was playing saxophone.
Was he playing alto or tenor?
Alto. He never did play tenor.
Uh huh. Yeah I've heard those records and it sounds like Cordilla to me on clarinet.
It is Cordilla on clarinet and it's rap on saxophone. On alto saxophone.
Was there one in the title called Pussycat Rag or something? Yeah I made that.
